about.title: Engineer. Designer. Innovator.
about.summary: Project Engineer with 6 years of experience managing end-to-end engineering projects from planning to execution. Proven expertise in product development, CAD design (SolidWorks, AutoCAD), GD&T, and manufacturing process optimization. Successfully led cross-functional teams to deliver projects within stringent timelines. Proficient in design for manufacturing (DFM), process validation, and quality assurance, with a strong ability to bridge design engineering and production for optimal efficiency.

design.methodology.diameter.title: DIAMETER (3-POINT CIRCLE FIT)
design.methodology.diameter.desc: Fits a circumscribed circle through 3 points on a cylindrical or circular edge to compute the diameter.
design.methodology.diameter.step1: Click 3 points along a circular feature (bore, shaft, fillet)
design.methodology.diameter.step2: Algorithm computes circumscribed circle in 3D space
design.methodology.diameter.step3: Displays fitted circle, center marker, and ⌀ dimension
design.methodology.angle.title: ANGLE (3-POINT VERTEX)
design.methodology.angle.desc: Measures the included angle at a vertex defined by 3 surface points (A → B → C, angle at B).
design.methodology.angle.step4: Displays angle in degrees with visual arc
design.methodology.pitch.title: PITCH (TOOTH/THREAD SPACING)
design.methodology.pitch.desc: Measures the linear pitch between two adjacent gear teeth or thread crests.
design.methodology.pitch.step1: Click the tip of one tooth/thread crest
design.methodology.pitch.step2: Click the corresponding point on the next tooth/thread
